answer: Proof of Compute serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism in decentralized AI economies. By requiring agents to solve cryptographically verifiable puzzles, the network forces an attacker to exhaust physical resources rather than creating an identity island. A malicious actor attempting to flood the network with fake nodes faces a plume of capital expenditure costs that scale linearly with the gale of computational demand, rendering large-scale deception economically irrational and computationally prohibitive.
